brokers.title: Indian brokers by NSE active clients
brokers.definition: An NSE active client is a unique client code that has traded at least once in the preceding twelve months. This is not the same as demat accounts, registered users or app downloads.
brokers.industryNote: NSE active clients stood at approximately 45.5 million through the first seven months of calendar 2026. The industry added only about 8,000 net active clients in July.
notes: HDFC Securities lost 9,169 active clients in July. SBI Securities recorded the sharpest fall among traditional brokers at 47,551. Motilal Oswal declined by 1,748. Their closing totals were not stated in the reports consulted and are therefore not listed above.

Share percentages are shown only where they were explicitly reported. Where a percentage was not reported it is left blank rather than derived, because the exact industry denominator for the month was not confirmed.
Client counts are reported to three significant figures in the sources used. They are not exact to the individual client.
